{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABeiBhjg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIDDEg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 301, "title": "Remove horizontal divider beneath Graph Editor Inspector header", "body": "## Goal

Remove the **horizontal divider directly below the right-hand Graph Editor Inspector header** (the row containing **Details** or **Settings** and, when a node is selected, the **Remove Node** button).

The line is unnecessary visual clutter. Preserve the rest of the Inspector layout and functionality.

## Current implementation

In [`extension/graph.css`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph.css), the divider is drawn by:

```css
.editor-page .graph-inspector-header {
  padding-bottom: .5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
```

[`extension/graph-editor.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-editor.js) constructs the `.graph-inspector-header` in `drawInspector()`:

- Heading is **Details** for no node/connection or **Settings** when a node is selected.
- The **Remove Node** button is appended to that header when applicable.
- The contents of the Inspector render below the header.

## Requested change

1. Remove the `border-bottom` from `.editor-page .graph-inspector-header`.
2. Keep sensible vertical spacing between the header and subsequent Inspector content (retain or minimally adjust `padding-bottom` as needed); **do not replace the line with another divider**.
3. Preserve the header's flex layout, heading, conditional **Remove Node** action, subsequent settings/port help/connection details, selection behavior, and keyboard/accessibility behavior.
4. Apply consistently in all Inspector states (no selection / selected node / selected connection / subgraph Inspector) and at desktop and narrow extension widths.
5. Keep the change visually scoped to the **Graph Editor Inspector**. Do not remove borders elsewhere, including node cards, fields, menus, or canvas wires.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No horizontal separator line appears immediately below the Inspector's Details/Settings and Remove Node header.
- [ ] Header and content retain readable spacing, with no awkward extra blank gap.
- [ ] Node selection, Remove Node, node settings, connections, and exposed-port controls still work normally.
- [ ] Layout remains legible on narrow and desktop widths.
- [ ] Existing relevant layout/Inspector tests pass. No graph data, runtime behavior, or storage changes.

## Implementation and tests

- Primary target: [`extension/graph.css`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph.css).
- Inspector rendering is in [`extension/graph-editor.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-editor.js); code changes there should not be necessary.
- Check the existing layout/Inspector browser tests for regressions; a targeted styling regression assertion is welcome if suitable.

This is a small, independent visual cleanup. Coordinate with [#299](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/299) and [#300](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/300) only if they touch nearby Graph Editor UI; do not broaden scope.
